title: Talktool — dial-and-use live phone translation (capability marker, window closing)
method: X/PH daily batch 2026-08-13, judged under STANDARD
pain: An immigrant calling a landlord, a hospital or a government office in a language they do not speak — an old, heavy, verified pain.
gap: Almost none left. Interpreter lines are expensive and appointment-based, and app-based translation needs both parties to install it — but Apple shipped Live Translation on calls in iOS 26, which is where most of this window went.
kill: Platform shadow of the heaviest kind: the OS and the carrier both sit above this, and both are shipping it natively. What remains is the residue — non-iPhone users, three-way institutional calls, and language pairs the platforms do not cover well.
move: Nothing to build here. Filed as the date-stamp for when 'call someone with no shared language, no app, no appointment' became ordinary.
wallet: 强：口译服务本来就是按分钟收费的成熟付费行为——但钱包信号强不代表缺口在，这条恰是反例
evidence: Apple Live Translation on calls (iOS 26) 是这条窗口的主要吞噬者

zh.pain: 一个移民打电话给房东、医院、政府办事处，而对面说的是他不会的语言——这是一条又老又重、早被验证的痛。
zh.gap: 几乎没剩多少了。人工口译贵且要预约，App 翻译要双方都装——但 Apple 在 iOS 26 已经把通话实时翻译做进系统，这扇窗大半是被它吃掉的。
zh.kill: 最重的一种平台阴影：操作系统和运营商都压在上面，而且两边都在原生做。剩下的只是残渣——非 iPhone 用户、三方机构通话、平台覆盖不好的语种。
zh.move: 这里没有可动手的东西。留档是给「跟没有共同语言的人通话，不装 App、不用预约」变成寻常事的那一天记个日期。
zh.wallet: 强：口译按分钟收费本就是成熟付费行为——但钱包信号强不代表缺口在，这条正是反例
